strategic_themes.label: Trust and transparency
strategic_themes.definition: Feedback about whether the company appears credible and communicates its commercial practices clearly.

midlevel_themes.label: Public reputation
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about signals that affect confidence in the company's public reputation.

specific_themes.label: Review authenticity
specific_themes.definition: Questions or concerns about whether published customer reviews are genuine.

midlevel_themes.label: Pricing and fees
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about charges, pricing, and how they are communicated.

specific_themes.label: Fee transparency
specific_themes.definition: How clearly the purpose or composition of fees is explained.

strategic_themes.label: Financing operations
strategic_themes.definition: Feedback about operational steps in invoice financing and debt recovery.

midlevel_themes.label: Fund disbursement
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about receiving funds after an invoice is submitted or approved.

specific_themes.label: Payout timing
specific_themes.definition: The elapsed time between invoice processing or approval and payout.

midlevel_themes.label: Collections process
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about how overdue amounts and collections cases are handled.

specific_themes.label: Collections communication
specific_themes.definition: Whether and how the customer is contacted before or during collections.

strategic_themes.label: Service experience
strategic_themes.definition: Feedback about help received from people or automated support channels.

midlevel_themes.label: Customer support
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about access to support and the quality of follow-up.

specific_themes.label: Support responsiveness
specific_themes.definition: How quickly or reliably support responds to a request.

specific_themes.label: Proactive follow-up
specific_themes.definition: Whether support takes ownership and follows up without repeated prompting.

strategic_themes.label: Digital experience
strategic_themes.definition: Feedback about using the company's digital portal and its capabilities.

midlevel_themes.label: Online portal
midlevel_themes.definition: Feedback about portal access, usability, performance, and features.

specific_themes.label: Portal access
specific_themes.definition: The ability to log in to and access the portal.

specific_themes.label: Portal usability
specific_themes.definition: How easy, clear, or modern the portal is to use.

specific_themes.label: Portal performance
specific_themes.definition: The speed and responsiveness of the portal.

specific_themes.label: Data export
specific_themes.definition: The ability to download portal data in reusable formats.
